period_note: RESTATEMENT-RELEVANT PERIOD. Half-Yearly filing (no discrete Q2-only statement is separately published): 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (Q-2) From 01 January 2023 to 30 June 2023' -- balance sheet is the 30-June-2023 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone, Shariah-based Islamic bank. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January (H1-cumulative); the filing's own table also prints a discrete 'April'23-June'23' column, captured as the _discrete_quarter fields. Source PDF ('2nd-q-ubl.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 30 July 2023' signature block) is a SCANNED IMAGE document with a severely corrupted embedded text layer (broken font/ligature encoding scrambling digits, e.g. rendering '17,145,838,272' as '1,7,1.45,838,27 2') -- independently OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) instead. Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly on the OCR'd figures: Total Liabilities (257,934,179,831) + Total Equity (15,584,838,337) = Total Assets (273,519,018,168). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (4,112,343,947) - Total Operating Expenses (2,084,891,878) = Profit before Provision and Tax (2,027,452,069); - Total Provisions (431,000,000) = Total Profit before Tax (1,596,452,069); - Tax (756,985,183) = Net Profit after Tax (839,466,886, matching the OCR of this filing's own P&L and independently cross-validated exactly against Union Bank's own 2024_Q2 filing, which reproduces 'Jan'23-June'23' as its prior-year comparative). EPS (cumulative, 0.84) is likewise cross-referenced from that same 2024 Q2 comparative column, since this filing's own broken text layer rendered EPS ambiguously; the underlying PAT/weighted-average-shares arithmetic (839,466,886 / ~1,001,655,976 weighted-average shares, per this filing's own Note, reflecting the mid-quarter 5% bonus share issue that raised paid-up capital from 9,869.34m to 10,362.80m) is consistent with 0.84. 'Investments Income' and 'Profit Paid on Deposits' (gross, pre-netting) could not be legibly recovered from either this filing's own OCR or a cross-reference (both rows were corrupted/dropped in this specific filing across all captures checked) -- omitted rather than guessed; Net Investment Income (the netted, decision-useful figure) is fully reliable. nav_per_share here (15.04) is calculated on PERIOD-END shares outstanding (1,036,280,448, consistent with this dataset's general 'calculated_period_end_not_average' convention) rather than the weighted-average-shares basis the bank's own Note 14 uses (which gives NAV=15.56, using 1,001,655,976 weighted-average shares reflecting the mid-quarter bonus issue) -- both are legitimate, differing only in share-count convention; the bank's own reported figure is noted here for transparency. RESTATEMENT TIMING FINDING: this filing's own December-2022 comparative matches this dataset's stored FY2022 figures exactly (no FY2022 restatement). This quarter shows a 5% bonus share issue, a cash dividend payout, and continued healthy, growing cumulative profit (839.47m vs 770.39m in H1 2022) -- again no visible sign of the classified-investment manipulation that would surface only in the FY2024 report filed over two years later. The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures.
